title: Powertoys Run: allow use of symlinks
author: bugficks
summary: PowerToys Run intentionally skips Start Menu reparse-point directories, so programs reachable only through symlinks or junctions are not indexed.
next_action: Reclassify as an enhancement requiring cycle detection, scope limits, and duplicate handling.

confidence.rationale: The maintainer explicitly documents the design intent and the proposed patch omits cycle controls.

judgment.rationale: A maintainer states the exclusion was deliberately added to prevent recursive directory loops; supporting links requires a bounded traversal feature design, not removing the guard as a bug fix.
evidence: The report links the code that skips `FileAttributes.ReparsePoint`.
A maintainer says the line was intentionally added after recursive loops caused infinite querying.
The proposed patch resolves links but does not specify a visited-target set, traversal boundary, or duplicate-result behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Reclassify as an enhancement requiring cycle detection, scope limits, and duplicate handling.

fix_assessment.rationale: Skipping reparse points is intentional safety behavior; link traversal is a new bounded-indexing capability.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run intentionally skips Start Menu reparse-point directories, so programs reachable only through symlinks or junctions are not indexed.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.72.0.
Both directory symlinks and junctions are requested.
The use case is recursively indexing a custom Start Menu path.
inferences: Resolving final targets alone does not prevent cycles formed by multiple links or targets that lead back into an ancestor.
issue_context.analysis: The current behavior is a safety boundary. Any change must preserve termination and define how linked paths are deduplicated and permission failures are handled.
initial_investigation: Read the full report, proposed code sketch, and maintainer response.
Evaluated the suggested target resolution against the stated recursive-loop risk.

actions.label: Reclassify as bounded symlink indexing

comment.body: PowerToys Run intentionally skips reparse-point directories because following them previously allowed recursive loops and unbounded querying. Supporting Start Menu symlinks or junctions should therefore be tracked as an enhancement, not by simply removing `FileAttributes.ReparsePoint`. A viable design needs canonical target tracking, cycle detection, traversal limits, permission handling, and duplicate-result rules.
